set_aside.subject: same-session retry after an accepted import
set_aside.text: “A confirmation refused because the closure exists — made by any import accepted before it, of another session or of this one” conflicts with A13 rule 6 and the stated stage order: the accepted submission has already used up that session’s pending confirmation value, so its retry is refused at stage (1) before the closure is checked.
set_aside.question: When the same owner session resubmits the confirmation value of an import that already succeeded, is the request refused as an invalid or absent confirmation at stage (1), or as an import permanently closed by the migration closure?
options: Refuse at stage (1) because the confirmation value was already used; do not inspect the closure.
Treat the existing closure as the refusal despite the used confirmation value, and report the import as closed.
set_aside.default_guess: Follow A13 and A04 ordering: refuse at stage (1) for the used confirmation value, without reaching the closure check.

witness.initial: One owner session has an uploaded file and a valid pending confirmation value C; no migration closure exists.
events: The owner submits C in that session; Registry accepts and commits the import, writes the closure, uses up C, and drops every upload.
The response is lost, so the owner resubmits C from the same still-valid session.
outcomes: The changed import outcome says the closure made by this session causes a permanent closure refusal, with no step shown again.
A13 rule 6 and the stage order say C is no longer pending, so stage (1) refuses the confirmation and the migration closure is never checked.
witness.observer: The owner, through the refusal response and resulting owner-interface flow.
